purpose: Start a component-by-component Earth calibration programme, with independent household/land/work evidence before retuning the shared food/settlement/control chain.

source.status: Schema, codebooks, source processing code and categorical vocabularies inspected; labour/yield outcomes not scored before this plan.

first_observable: Reported human reaping/harvesting hours per independently reported sole-cereal cropped hectare, with independent household size and management flags. This does not calibrate the entire annual-work or food-provisioning model.
period_transfer: Modern field evidence can test units, allocation and manual-task plausibility. It cannot directly establish 200 AD workforce shares, work calendars, annual availability, yields, grain claims or rights.

data_rules.area_unit: acre; convert with 0.40468564224 hectare/acre, matching the source codebook
data_rules.mechanization: Exclude any machinery-coded harvest row, including an explicitly machinery-coded row with missing quantities; absent machinery records do not prove no machinery.
data_rules.analogue_subgroup: Report an additional strict recorded-input subgroup: zero recorded irrigation and no machinery, mineral fertilizer, pesticide or weedicide rows in the same plot-season. Not proof of ancient technology. Do not silently relax if small.
data_rules.no_value_as_quantity: Never substitute crop revenue for grain kg or wages for hours. Missing grain quantities or unrecognized units stay unscored. No household population inferred from crop output.
data_rules.duplicate_work_events: Exclude a plot-season when human harvest rows repeat the same operation, survey round, date and labour type; do not silently sum or deduplicate ambiguous event records.
data_rules.mixed_harvest_operations: Exclude plot-seasons with human harvesting/reaping rows outside the declared exact-task regex, including bundled harvesting/threshing or binding.

split.method: SHA256 of 'rotclimate-vdsa-reaping-v1|' plus canonical district; first 8 hex digits divided by 2^32
split.panel_rule: All plots, households, villages and years in a district remain in one split. Do not tune splits to outcomes.

selection.model: One shared multiplicative scale on Columella reaping coefficients: wheat 48, barley 32 human hours/ha under the existing 8 h/day and 0.25 ha/iugerum scenario.
selection.objective: Equal-district mean absolute log10 prediction error; median of log(observed/baseline) with each district given equal total weight.
selection.heldout_access: Commit plan before preparation/scoring; commit selection plus complete identities before evaluation. Never fit on evaluation targets.

evaluation.qualification: At least 5% lower primary error than the fixed baseline, subject to sample minima. All subgroup outcomes reported; no per-region universal-improvement veto.
evaluation.adoption: Never change production defaults from this modern-only experiment. Additional historical/technology-transfer evidence is required even if the modern comparator improves.

protection.climate: No Earth physics tuning or sealed climate-set access
protection.workforce: Household size and working-age counts are not actual full-time farm-worker counts
protection.food: Actual rural diet, marketed surplus, stored food and import needs require independent measurements; do not infer them from potential yield.
